我想做一个提高智能生活设备认知的 Campaign，受众是喜欢科技的年轻工作者。请先帮我规划两种创作者类型，我们再一起确定筛选范围，不要立即启动。

可以，**先规划，不启动搜索或研究**。这次的目标是提高智能生活设备认知，受众是喜欢科技的年轻工作者；建议用两种互补类型，分别解决“设备能做什么”和“与我的生活有什么关系”。

### 两种创作者类型建议

| 类型 | 如何支持目标 | 建议内容形式 | 建议必选条件（待你确认） |
|---|---|---|---|
| **1. 智能生活设备体验／科普型** | 把产品功能、使用方式和适用边界讲清楚，降低理解门槛 | 实际使用演示、入门解释、设备联动、优缺点对比 | 有智能生活设备相关内容；分享实际使用经验；能说明具体功能或应用方式 |
| **2. 年轻工作者生活效率／场景型** | 将设备融入工作日与居家生活，让受众理解实际价值 | 下班回家流程、居家办公、早晨例程、清洁与生活自动化 | 有面向工作或日常生活的场景内容；展示科技设备或工具的实际使用；说明设备解决的具体问题 |

两组的区别是：**第一组从设备出发解释能力，第二组从生活问题出发解释用途**。第二组不必限定为纯科技博主，但也不应仅凭生活方式内容就判定适合。

### 先确认这三件事
1. **产品范围**：具体推广什么？例如智能照明、清洁设备、安防、音箱或全屋联动；还是多个品类的智能生活概念？
2. **市场与平台**：主要面向哪个国家／地区、使用什么内容语言、希望在哪个平台投放？创作者所在地是否也有限制？
3. **认知目标**：更重视让受众认识品类及用途，还是认识某个品牌／产品及其功能？

如果暂时没有规模偏好，可以先讨论这个**建议起点**：每组入选 **3人**、逐人分析预算 **12人**，粉丝 **1万–10万**。这些不是已确认条件，也不会自动沿用此前研究的范围。

你回答后，我们再确定两组的平台、所在地、粉丝范围、必选条件、偏好及预算，保存为待确认草案；**只有你明确确认后才启动**。

两组就按这个来：实用数码体验组、生活效率工具组，每组1位且同一平台账号总共只能占一个组。两组都只考虑 Instagram 的 tylerlcrawford 与 valstechtalkk，v3，地区不限，粉丝1万到10万，每组逐人分析预算2，两位都完整分析并标注。第一组必选本人有实际数码产品使用经验，第二组必选本人有科技产品或工具使用经验。只依据已有文字、不打开网页。标注实际内容方向和文字呈现风格。请将与提高智能生活设备认知的关联写在各类型理由中，保存待确认的 Campaign 方案。

| **实用数码体验组** | 通过本人实际使用经验解释设备功能、使用方式与体验价值，降低受众理解智能生活设备的门槛。 | 本人有实际数码产品使用经验 | 1位／2人 |

上述关联已写入各类型理由，**没有额外增加智能家居内容、职业身份或效率场景等硬条件**。

1. **“geek风”指什么？**  
   是外观／穿搭上的书卷气、极客感，还是要求本人分享科技、编程、游戏等内容？若是内容方向，请说明哪些算。

2. **“欧美白人”的范围怎么定？**  
   创作者所在地是限定**美国、加拿大及哪些欧洲国家**，还是所在地不限？白人身份只能依据本人明确自述核验，不能从肤色、长相或姓名推断；没有自述证据的会标为待核实。

3. **戴眼镜的要求是什么？**  
   近期内容中经常佩戴普通眼镜即可，还是需要大多数出镜都戴？太阳镜是否排除？

另外建议设置**逐人分析预算100位，目标入选20位**；这是分析人数上限，不是付费金额，也不保证一定凑齐。你是否接受？

KOC 会另设必选条件：**个人消费者型创作者，以本人体验和分享为主，排除品牌、公司或店铺官方账号**。视觉风格和戴眼镜需要观察实际内容，不能仅凭头像判断。确认上述口径后再开始；此前研究和 Campaign 保持不变。

{"caption":"My apartment runs itself, and this one is everything that happens while I am asleep.

Shades close at 9:22. Kitchen shelf lights shut off at 9:50, which is my signal that the day is over. The Pura kicks on lavender. My Eight Sleep adjusts the bed temperature all night based on my body. The humidifier holds the room at 60%. And 45 minutes after sunrise the blackout layer opens first, then the solar shades, so I wake up to the skyline instead of an alarm.

I set all of it up once and it has run every night since. That is the whole point of the hometel.

Save this for when you are ready to automate your own space and send it to whoever you share a bed with.

{"caption":"My apartment runs itself, and this one is everything that happens while I am asleep.

Shades close at 9:22. Kitchen shelf lights shut off at 9:50, which is my signal that the day is over. The Pura kicks on lavender. My Eight Sleep adjusts the bed temperature all night based on my body. The humidifier holds the room at 60%. I set all of it up once and it has run every night since. That is the whole point of the hometel.

Save this for when you are ready to automate your own space and send it to whoever you share a bed with.

{"caption":"My apartment runs itself, and this one is everything that happens while I am asleep.

Shades close at 9:22. Kitchen shelf lights shut off at 9:50, which is my signal that the day is over. The Pura kicks on lavender. My Eight Sleep adjusts the bed temperature all night based on my body. The humidifier holds the room at 60%. And 45 minutes after sunrise the blackout layer opens first, then the solar shades, so I wake up to the skyline instead of an alarm.

I set all of it up once and it has run every night since. That is the whole point of the hometel.

Save this for when you are ready to automate your own space and send it to whoever you share a bed with.

#smarthome #homeautomation #hometel #eightsleep #sleeproutine","likes":76446,"comments":366,"photoCount":0,"videoCoverCount":1}

{"caption":"My apartment basically runs itself, and I’m not exaggerating.

{"caption":"I have the 16 Pro, 17 Pro, and 18 Pro, so I shot the same things on all three to figure out who should actually upgrade.

Each year changed a different part of the camera. The 17 Pro was about zoom and selfies, with a zoom lens four times sharper and a front camera that auto-rotates and reframes. The 18 Pro changed none of that. Same zoom lens, same sensor. What’s new is a main camera that physically opens and closes, pulling in about 50 percent more light at night or closing down to keep more of the scene sharp, plus manual control for the first time.

On a 16 Pro, upgrade. You get two years at once. On a 17 Pro, only if you shoot low light or want manual control. And the 16 Pro actually zooms further than both.

Save this before you buy and send it to your friend who upgrades every single year.

{"caption":"My apartment runs itself, and this one is everything that happens while I am asleep.

Shades close at 9:22. Kitchen shelf lights shut off at 9:50, which is my signal that the day is over. The Pura kicks on lavender. My Eight Sleep adjusts the bed temperature all night based on my body. The humidifier holds the room at 60%. And 45 minutes after sunrise the blackout layer opens first, then the solar shades, so I wake up to the skyline instead of an alarm.

I set all of it up once and it has run every night since. That is the whole point of the hometel.

Save this for when you are ready to automate your own space and send it to whoever you share a bed with.

{"caption":"I have the 16 Pro, 17 Pro, and 18 Pro, so I shot the same things on all three to figure out who should actually upgrade.

Each year changed a different part of the camera. The 17 Pro was about zoom and selfies, with a zoom lens four times sharper and a front camera that auto-rotates and reframes. The 18 Pro changed none of that. Same zoom lens, same sensor. What’s new is a main camera that physically opens and closes, pulling in about 50 percent more light at night or closing down to keep more of the scene sharp, plus manual control for the first time.

On a 16 Pro, upgrade. You get two years at once. On a 17 Pro, only if you shoot low light or want manual control. And the 16 Pro actually zooms further than both.

Save this before you buy and send it to your friend who upgrades every single year.

{"caption":"My apartment runs itself, and this one is everything that happens while I am asleep.

Shades close at 9:22. Kitchen shelf lights shut off at 9:50, which is my signal that the day is over. The Pura kicks on lavender. My Eight Sleep adjusts the bed temperature all night based on my body. The humidifier holds the room at 60%. And 45 minutes after sunrise the blackout layer opens first, then the solar shades, so I wake up to the skyline instead of an alarm.

I set all of it up once and it has run every night since. That is the whole point of the hometel.

Save this for when you are ready to automate your own space and send it to whoever you share a bed with.

{"caption":"I have the 16 Pro, 17 Pro, and 18 Pro, so I shot the same things on all three to figure out who should actually upgrade.

可以，**先规划，不启动搜索或研究**。这次的目标是提高智能生活设备认知，受众是喜欢科技的年轻工作者；建议用两种互补类型，分别解决“设备能做什么”和“与我的生活有什么关系”。

### 两种创作者类型建议

| 类型 | 如何支持目标 | 建议内容形式 | 建议必选条件（待你确认） |
|---|---|---|---|
| **1. 智能生活设备体验／科普型** | 把产品功能、使用方式和适用边界讲清楚，降低理解门槛 | 实际使用演示、入门解释、设备联动、优缺点对比 | 有智能生活设备相关内容；分享实际使用经验；能说明具体功能或应用方式 |
| **2. 年轻工作者生活效率／场景型** | 将设备融入工作日与居家生活，让受众理解实际价值 | 下班回家流程、居家办公、早晨例程、清洁与生活自动化 | 有面向工作或日常生活的场景内容；展示科技设备或工具的实际使用；说明设备解决的具体问题 |

两组的区别是：**第一组从设备出发解释能力，第二组从生活问题出发解释用途**。第二组不必限定为纯科技博主，但也不应仅凭生活方式内容就判定适合。

### 先确认这三件事
1. **产品范围**：具体推广什么？例如智能照明、清洁设备、安防、音箱或全屋联动；还是多个品类的智能生活概念？
2. **市场与平台**：主要面向哪个国家／地区、使用什么内容语言、希望在哪个平台投放？创作者所在地是否也有限制？
3. **认知目标**：更重视让受众认识品类及用途，还是认识某个品牌／产品及其功能？

如果暂时没有规模偏好，可以先讨论这个**建议起点**：每组入选 **3人**、逐人分析预算 **12人**，粉丝 **1万–10万**。这些不是已确认条件，也不会自动沿用此前研究的范围。

你回答后，我们再确定两组的平台、所在地、粉丝范围、必选条件、偏好及预算，保存为待确认草案；**只有你明确确认后才启动**。
